cycles.correction: Added an explicit test-discovery bootstrap shared by every acceptance-test module so a fresh checkout is self-contained.

cycles.reason: All 24 tests were discovered, but FFmpeg's unbounded thread selection exceeded the verifier's process/address-space limits and the loopback API test inherited the deliberately dead outbound proxy.
